_comment: Domain context router table. One entry per subject domain of the game.
The router (.claude/hooks/domain-context-router.ps1) reads this on every
UserPromptSubmit and injects a load instruction for the matching domain skill.
Adding a domain = add an entry here + create .claude/skills/<skill>/SKILL.md.
The router never touches: it only emits for domains whose skill exists on disk,
so an entry with no skill yet is inert instead of promising context that is
not there. Add its cases to hooks/tests/test_domain_router.py in the same commit.
Patterns are matched case-insensitively against the prompt. Keep them ASCII:
write the unaccented substring ('rbol' matches arbol and arbol with accent,
'vegetaci' matches vegetacion and vegetacion with accent) so the table stays
readable from PowerShell 5 regardless of file encoding.

domains.name: terrain
domains._note: 'mapa' deliberately absent: nearly every floor-1 request says it, and a mutation run showed it pulling terrain into a bush prompt. Match the terrain itself, not the place it lives in.
